title: 5 Days 5 Marathon OWS: Set 1 (Q1 to Q25)
subtitle: Theocracy to Catastrophe

words.hindi: धर्मगुरुओं का शासन
words.meaning: A system of government where priests or religious leaders rule in the name of God.
words.example: In a theocracy, religious leaders hold the highest political power.

words.hindi: तितलियों और पतंगों का अध्ययन करने वाला
words.meaning: A person who collects or studies butterflies and moths.
words.example: The lepidopterist documented rare species of butterflies in the valley.

words.hindi: दवाइयों की दुकान
words.meaning: A shop or place where you can buy medicines.
words.example: He went to the nearby pharmacy to buy prescribed tablets.

words.hindi: डाक टिकटों का संग्रह करने वाला
words.meaning: A person who loves and collects postage stamps.
words.example: As a passionate philatelist, he owns stamps from over fifty countries.

words.hindi: पाँच पंक्तियों की मज़ेदार कविता
words.meaning: A humorous poem of five lines.
words.example: The poet entertained the audience with a clever limerick.

words.hindi: बच्चों का डॉक्टर
words.meaning: A doctor who treats children.
words.example: The paediatrician checked the baby's fever and prescribed syrup.

words.hindi: शराब बिल्कुल न पीने वाला
words.meaning: A person who completely abstains from alcoholic drinks.
words.example: He is a strict teetotaller and never touches alcohol even at parties.

words.hindi: जिसे खुश करना कठिन हो और जो जल्दी कमी निकालता हो
words.meaning: Quick to find fault, very attentive to detail, and hard to please.
words.example: The chairman is fastidious and inspects every small detail carefully.

words.hindi: लिखावट और उसके ढंग का अध्ययन करने वाला
words.meaning: One who studies the physical characteristics and patterns of handwriting.
words.example: The police hired a graphologist to examine the suspect's handwriting.

words.hindi: कुलीन (उच्च) वर्ग का शासन
words.meaning: A government ruled by nobility or the privileged upper class.
words.example: In medieval Europe, political power was largely controlled by the aristocracy.

words.hindi: कीड़ों का अध्ययन करने वाला वैज्ञानिक
words.meaning: A person who studies insects scientifically.
words.example: The entomologist examined the beetles under a microscope.

words.hindi: बहस करने वाला / विवादप्रिय
words.meaning: A person who likes to argue about anything; causing disagreement.
words.example: The contentious man argued with everyone during the meeting.

words.hindi: सच्ची और रोचक छोटी कहानी / किस्सा
words.meaning: A short interesting story about a real person or event.
words.example: He shared a funny anecdote from his college days with his friends.

words.hindi: दोपहर के भोजन के बाद की छोटी नींद
words.meaning: A short rest or sleep taken after lunch.
words.example: He enjoyed a relaxing siesta after lunch on Sunday.

words.hindi: चुपके से भाग जाना / फ़रार होना
words.meaning: To go away suddenly and secretly in order to escape from somewhere.
words.example: The fraudster absconded and left the country before the arrest warrant arrived.

words.hindi: खाने योग्य
words.meaning: A thing fit and safe to be eaten.
words.example: These fresh forest fruits are completely edible.

words.hindi: टकसाल (सिक्के बनाने का स्थान)
words.meaning: A place where coins, medals, or tokens are made.
words.example: Indian coins are manufactured in the government mint.

words.hindi: मृत्यु का कारण जानने के लिए मानव शव की जाँच
words.meaning: An examination of a dead human body to determine the cause of death.
words.example: The forensic doctor performed an autopsy to find the exact cause of death.

words.hindi: आत्महत्या (स्वयं की जान लेना)
words.meaning: The act of intentionally killing oneself.
words.example: Mental health helplines work to prevent cases of suicide.

words.hindi: शून्यवाद (यह विश्वास कि कुछ भी वास्तव में मौजूद नहीं है)
words.meaning: The belief that nothing really exists or that life has no intrinsic meaning.
words.example: After facing repeated failures, he temporarily embraced nihilism.

words.hindi: बंधन से मुक्त करना / आज़ाद करना
words.meaning: To free from restraint, control, or legal/social restrictions.
words.example: India was emancipated from British colonial rule in 1947.

words.hindi: सेना द्वारा संचालित शासन-व्यवस्था
words.meaning: A system of government ruled by the military.
words.example: A stratocracy places supreme governing power in the hands of army chiefs.

words.hindi: नींद में बोलने वाला व्यक्ति
words.meaning: A person who talks while sleeping.
words.example: He is a somniloquist and often mutters full sentences at night.

words.hindi: बुढ़ापे और वृद्धावस्था की प्रक्रिया का अध्ययन
words.meaning: The scientific study of old age and various aspects of aging.
words.example: Advances in gerontology have improved healthcare for senior citizens.

words.hindi: बड़ी और अचानक आने वाली आपदा
words.meaning: A sudden widespread disaster causing great damage or suffering.
words.example: The massive earthquake was a terrible catastrophe for the entire region.
